added.title: Vice President of Product, Consumer Experience and AI Platform
added.description:
Vice President of Product, Consumer Experience and AI Platform

A Place for Mom (APFM) | NYC - Remote * Could be 100% remote of local to our NYC Office

The Role

A Place for Mom is the largest senior care marketplace in North America. Around 27 million people come to us each year at one of the hardest moments of their lives. We are hiring a Vice President of Product to be the single threaded owner of the demand side of this marketplace, end to end. Traffic, conversion, and the yield.
In this role you will own the family journey from first search to move in and beyond, and you will own the AI intelligence and orchestration engine that makes that journey work: the agents, the context and memory layer, the decision and routing intelligence, the conversational runtime, and the evaluation discipline that earns a family the right to trust it. This is a senior leadership role reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

Ownership: The Full Funnel

You own the funnel end to end. Below are the controllable inputs you and your team are accountable for, and the output you deliver on.
Traffic and discovery.
Organic search, answer engine and AI assistant presence, paid efficiency and mix, brand surfaces, content and in language coverage, partnership and syndication placement. You carry qualified session growth and our share of AI mediated discovery.
Conversion.
Registration and identity capture, intake and readiness qualification, conversational runtime across chat, voice and SMS, decision and routing accuracy, agent to human escalation, speed to first response. You own sessions to lead, lead to referral, referral to move in, and time to move in conversion.
Monetization.
Match and routing economics, yield per visit across the supply tiers, pricing surfaces that families see, post placement attach and the cross-product relationship.
Intelligence and orchestration.
Persona and context representation, the agent fleet and the orchestration layer that runs it, the decision engine, evaluation and safety, and the feedback loops that make every downstream system better. You carry routing and match quality, agentic coverage, safety posture, and platform adoption.

Key Responsibilities

Own the demand side Product.
Set the funnel strategy, the input metric targets behind it, and the operating cadence that holds them. Own the vision, defend the tradeoffs, and run the weekly review where inputs are inspected before outputs are explained.
Own the AI orchestration engine.
This is the core of the job. Multi agent orchestration and the agent fleet, model orchestration and routing across a portfolio of models, tool and API calling, prompt and guardrail management, retrieval over a twenty-five-year domain corpus, cross session memory, and the feedback loops that close between every outcome and the next decision.
Build the agentic family experience.
Today a family fills in a form and waits. The destination is an agentic experience that understands the situation, does the work, and hands them to a human at exactly the right moment. You own that transition, including the coverage targets that come with it and the guarantee that quality and family outcomes hold as agentic share rises.
Own context and memory.
The context graph and the entity state that persists across sessions, surfaces and brands, so a family is recognized and understood on the second visit rather than re-interviewed. This is the substrate the rest of the platform is built on and the dependency most likely to gate everything else.
Own decision and routing intelligence.
The engine that matches family intent to the right recommendation, advisor and provider across markets, signals and constraints. Small movements in routing accuracy are worth more than most features in the roadmap, and you will be expected to know that number and move it.
Make APFM AI callable, not just AI visible.
The capability manifest, the MCP surface, attribution, and the partnership posture that makes us the senior care endpoint other assistants and agents reach for. Being cited is the floor. Being called is the position.
Run the platform as a product.
Provider and advisor product teams are your customers for shared AI services. You owe them a roadmap.
Build the team.
A senior product organization that holds consumer product judgment and applied AI credibility at the same time, and ships.

What You Will Be Measured On

Conversion.
Session to lead, lead to referral, referral to move in, and time to move in.
Traffic quality.
Qualified session growth and our share of AI mediated discovery, not raw volume.
Agentic coverage and quality.
The share of family interactions an agent can carry end to end, the rate and precision of escalation to a human, and the hard constraint that family outcomes and match quality do not degrade as that share grows.
AI quality, trust and cost.
Routing and match accuracy, evaluation discipline, safety posture, and the unit cost of an AI assisted conversation.
Platform leverage.
Adoption of shared AI services by the provider and advisor pillars, and how fast they can ship on what you build.
Team.
Depth of the leadership bench you build and the senior leaders you develop.

Basic Qualifications

12 or more years of product leadership, including significant senior people management and experience leading leaders.
Has built and taken high impact AI products to market. Production AI or ML at scale: ranking, recommendation, conversational AI, or applied LLM. This is a hard requirement, not a preference, and it is the bar most candidates for this role will not clear.
Has shipped agentic or orchestrated LLM systems in production, not prototypes. Multi step task execution, tool and API calling, guardrails, and a designed human escalation path, operating against real users at volume.
Has owned a full funnel or a P and L, not a stage. You have carried traffic, conversion and revenue for the same business at the same time, and you can explain the input metrics you used to move each one.
A track record running consumer products at meaningful scale: marketplaces, healthcare consumer technology, or high frequency consumer applications.
Technical depth. Credible in an architecture conversation with ML engineering, able to read research, understands training and inference trade offs including the cost side.
Strong opinions on AI safety, fairness and evaluation, with systems shipped under explicit safety constraints.
Has run a platform team whose customers were other product teams, holding a quality and roadmap commitment against competing priorities.
Exceptional written communication. You will write the narrative that sets the plan and defend it in front of a board.

Preferred Qualifications

Retrieval at production scale over a large proprietary corpus, and the evaluation discipline that goes with it.
Knowledge graph, entity resolution or persistent cross session memory systems in a consumer product.
Agent interoperability work: MCP or equivalent, tool manifests, agent to agent protocols, or attribution across AI intermediaries.
Marketplace ranking or matching ML experience.
Marketplace product experience across two or more sides: consumer and supply, or consumer and advisor.
Production voice experience, including latency, barge in and handoff design.
Healthcare or senior care consumer product experience, and familiarity with healthcare privacy frameworks.
Foundation model fine tuning, RLHF or reinforcement learning experience.
Post conversion lifecycle product experience: retention, longitudinal engagement, subscription.
Operating experience in a private equity backed business with a proof gate rhythm.

Why APFM

The category is at an inflection point and the demographic tailwind is not a projection we are arguing for. The 80 and over population roughly doubles by 2040, from about 13 million to 26 million. We have brand, scale, and 25 years of placement signal no one else has, including millions of advisor conversations captured as families are deciding. That corpus is the training and retrieval asset behind everything in this role, and the moat. The opportunity is to take that foundation and build the agentic care experience this moment deserves, with the funnel, the economics and the intelligence layer.
We are looking for the leader who has been waiting to build it.

Additional Information:

Compensation Base Salary: $300,000-320,000
Bonus: 30% of annual earnings

Benefits:

401(k) plus match
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Vision insurance
Paid Time Off

#remote
#hybrid

About A Place For Mom:

A Place for Mom is the leading platform guiding families through every stage of the aging journey. Together, we simplify the senior care search with free, personalized support — connecting caregivers and their loved ones to vetted providers from our network of 15,000+ senior living communities and home care agencies.
Since 2000, our teams have helped millions of families find care that fits their needs. Behind every referral and resource is a shared goal: to help families focus on what matters most — their love for each other.

We’re proud to be a mission-driven company where every role contributes to improving lives. Caring isn’t just a core value — it’s who we are. Whether you’re supporting families directly or driving innovation behind the scenes, your work at A Place for Mom makes a real difference.
Our Employees Live The Company Values Every Day:
Mission Over Me: We find purpose in helping caregivers and their senior loved ones while approaching our work with empathy.
Do Hard Things: We are energized by solving challenging problems and see it as an opportunity to grow.
Drive Outcomes as a Team: We each own the outcome but can only achieve it as a team.
Win The Right Way: We see organizational integrity as the foundation for how we operate.
Embrace Change: We innovate and constantly evolve.

Additional Information:

A Place for Mom has recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. APFM will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments, or access to financial accounts; and/or extend an offer without conducting an interview.

If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

added.description:
Description

In this role, you will be owning one or more products that are in production and getting in on the ground floor of new projects to bring Agentic AI to more developers worldwide. You will be responsible for revenue and adoption of the services. You'll use your passion for technology and solving customer problems to develop and drive product plans to develop an exciting offering for customers.

As a Principal Technical Product Manager, you will be part of the larger product leadership community at AWS. This community plays a critical role in the broad business planning, working closely with senior management to develop business targets and resource requirements, influences our long-term technical and business strategy, helps us hire talented team of PMs and ultimately enables us to deliver innovative new solutions rapidly. You will be seen as the subject matter expert for your area of focus within AWS Agentic AI services.

A successful candidate will bring a passion for technology services, strong business acumen and judgment, proven experience of launching products and building business around them, ability to define innovative, ground breaking products, desire to have an industry wide impact and ability to work within a fast moving environment in a large company to rapidly deliver services that have a broad business impact. You will manage and be responsible for understanding customer needs and delivering some of our most strategic technical projects, and have a significant bottom-line impact on our business and competitive position.

Key job responsibilities

Lead Product Definition – Own and drive the customer working backwards strategy, tenets, long-term goals and working backwards documents (press release, FAQ) including customer and market feedback, competitive analysis and business metrics to inform direction.

Define Product Vision – Including all aspects to future roadmap, investment, innovation and experimentation.

Execution of Product Planning and Development – Including customer goals and business requirements for product release, ensuring implementation is aligned with product goals and requirements, and ownership of product positioning.

Lead Product Launch – Own the GTM plan to deliver results that ensure the customer and business goals are met in operational launch plans.

Lead Operations – Including monitoring and response to customer feedback, continuous improvement and business growth

Lead interaction with Technical Team – Including helping the technical team make tradeoffs based on customer requirements, QA/testing of the product.

Business reporting - Track revenue and adoption on a daily basis. Own writing business reports on a weekly and monthly basis and review with leadership.

About The Team

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore enables developers to deploy and operate highly capable AI agents securely, at scale. It offers infrastructure purpose-built for dynamic agent workloads, tools to enhance agents, and essential controls for real-world deployment. AgentCore services can be used together or independently and work with any framework including CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Strands Agents, as well as any foundation model in or outside of Amazon Bedrock, giving you ultimate flexibility. AgentCore eliminates the undifferentiated heavy lifting of building specialized agent infrastructure, so you can accelerate agents to production.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

About The Job

The Gemini App organization is building a universal AI assistant designed to empower people, expand their curiosity, and help them learn, create, and solve problems across devices. Within the Gemini App team, the Youth Safety team is dedicated to ensuring that younger users (teens and children under 18) around the world have safe, age-appropriate, empowering, and positive experiences with generative AI.

As the Senior Product Manager for Gemini App Youth Safety, you will lead end-to-end product strategy and execution for the features, safeguards, and family controls on Gemini Apps. Operating at the intersection of consumer product innovation, AI safety research, and family trust, you will shape how younger generations interact with and benefit from generative AI. You will build core capabilities like family supervision tools, crisis support resources, and model use guardrails, while partnering closely with teams spanning AI Research, Engineering, UX, Trust and Safety, Kids and Family, and Legal to balance helpfulness, curiosity, and creativity with built-in protection and peace of mind for families worldwide.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

added.title: VP of Product
added.description:
Ref: NU-39518

NU Advisory Partners has been retained to lead the search for a VP of Product for a fast-growing, AI-native B2B SaaS company serving complex operational customers. Having recently closed a strategic growth investment, the company is scaling quickly and hiring senior functional leadership for the first time, starting with product. This is the company's first senior product hire: a player-coach who will own product and design, build out the team, and turn a hands-on founder's vision into a repeatable, evidence-driven roadmap.

About NU Advisory Partners

NU Advisory Partners is an AI-native executive search and advisory firm specializing in senior executive, operating, and board roles, with deep expertise in private capital-backed environments.

We're breaking the mold in an industry that hasn't changed in decades, pairing a top-tier team with tech, data, and AI to make search smarter, faster, and built for how businesses move today. The result? A better experience for clients, candidates, and ourselves. With 2,000+ searches and deep industry expertise, we deliver high-touch service and leadership talent that drives long-term value.

Key Responsibilities

Set the product strategy, turning business priorities and adoption data into a prioritized, sequenced roadmap for the company's platform
Institutionalize direct customer input as a standing operating rhythm across product and design, building systems for win/loss analysis, usage data, and structured interviews so decisions stay evidence-based
Advance the product's AI roadmap into more predictive and autonomous territory, evaluating each investment by the customer outcome it drives, not the novelty of the technology
Rebuild how the team develops product, using AI throughout discovery and delivery instead of leaning on conventional process frameworks
Take ownership of the design function, holding the team to a high standard of craft and clarity so that non-technical, frontline users find the product genuinely easy to use
Scale the function from a handful of people into a mature organization: recruit and develop product managers and designers, put real ownership and accountability in place, and add the people-management structure that's currently missing
Work in close partnership with a hands-on, product-minded founder and a strong engineering counterpart, creating just enough planning structure to keep founder-driven ideas moving fast without losing strategic coherence
Act as a visible advocate for the product's story, both internally with stakeholders and externally at conferences, webinars, and customer-facing events
Sit on the senior leadership team and represent product in company-wide strategic decisions
Build trust and influence with teams outside product's direct control, since progress depends on partnership rather than authority

Qualifications & Experience

Must be in Walnut Creek, CA twice a week.
10+ years of progressive B2B SaaS product leadership, with experience scaling a product organization through a significant multi-stage growth arc
Strong product craft across strategy, prioritization, and roadmap sequencing, backed by a systematic approach to gathering direct customer evidence
A demonstrated track record shipping AI- or ML-powered product features that produced measurable business results, not just AI as a bolt-on feature
Sharp product and design instincts, with a track record of shipping intuitive, polished experiences for less technical, frontline users
Background in vertical or workflow-heavy SaaS is a plus; specific industry experience is not required as long as you can get close to complex customers and ramp quickly in a new domain
An experienced people leader who has built and coached product and design talent, and who models accountability, low ego, and a bias toward action
A genuine player-coach: hands-on with the daily work while also setting and facilitating strategy, someone who builds rather than maintains
An energetic, compelling communicator, comfortable evangelizing the product to a room of customers as much as explaining technical nuance to a non-technical executive
A strong founder partner: someone with the confidence to push back, the humility to take founder input seriously, and enough influence to bring strong-willed stakeholders along using evidence rather than authority
Genuinely customer-obsessed, willing to spend real time directly with customers, and unafraid to break from rigid or outdated process thinking

How to Apply:

Submit your resume
Our team will review your application
If your experience aligns with the role, we'll reach out to discuss the opportunity further
Even if this role isn't the perfect match, we'll add you to our talent network for future opportunities

At NU Advisory Partners, we're committed to identifying and placing exceptional leaders in roles where they can drive meaningful impact. If your background aligns with this opportunity, we invite you to apply.

added.title: Head of Product
added.description:
About Healerz

Healerz is an early-stage US healthcare-AI company building tools intended to help physicians make and coordinate high-stakes care decisions using real-world data. We are focused on earning voluntary, repeated use from busy clinicians—not merely shipping features. The next stage is turning user insight into validated product decisions and measurable adoption.

About the Role

This is a true zero-to-one product leadership role for someone who knows how to earn voluntary, repeated use—not just ship a roadmap. You will own product strategy, run fast discovery and validation loops with real users, build and modify prototypes hands-on with modern AI tools, and work as a peer to our Head of Engineering to turn validated concepts into production. This role reports to the COO.

Responsibilities

• Product strategy and the roadmap. Own what gets built, why it matters, what comes first, and when to scale, change, or stop work.
• A fast discovery loop. Build working prototypes with AI tools in days, put them in front of clinicians and users, and make evidence-based decisions in weeks. Senior engineers turn validated concepts into production.
• User validation. Own the review panels and rubrics that turn structured clinician and user feedback into product decisions. A feature is not done until it clears the validation bar and passes a usability check with its intended users.
• Adoption and evidence. Own activation, engagement, and retention. Combine product data with qualitative feedback to understand what earns repeated use.
• The user-to-buyer evidence case. Our users are individual physicians and their delegated staff; the larger buyers are healthcare organizations. Instrument provider usage to demonstrate value to those buyers.
• The market relationship. Maintain weekly user conversations and represent the product with providers, prospective buyers, and at relevant industry events.
• Focus. Protect the few product bets that drive outcomes and stop work that does not.

What Success Looks Like

• At 90 days: you have run the loop end to end—prototype, validate, decide—and re-centered the roadmap on the product’s differentiating core.
• At 12 months: the differentiating experience is validated with users, improving on real usage, and showing measurable progress in adoption and market penetration; at least one organizational buyer is engaging with the usage evidence you have built.

Qualifications

• You have earned voluntary, repeated adoption. You can show how you improved activation, engagement, or retention on a product people chose to use.
• Senior product leadership at an early-stage company, with real zero-to-one experience.
• A product bet you walked away from based on live user evidence—and the judgment to know when to double down instead.
• Experience with products where the user and buyer can be different people, including instrumenting usage to demonstrate value to the buyer.
• Experience running expert or user validation panels and turning structured feedback into product decisions.
• Hands-on use of modern AI tools to create and modify working prototypes, plus sound judgment about where AI genuinely helps and where a simpler approach wins.
• Fluency with product data and feedback: instrumenting usage, designing qualitative and quantitative feedback loops, and using both to drive decisions.
• Player-coach range: on day one, you are the product function, and you will shape what it becomes.

Preferred Skills

• Healthcare experience is helpful but not required. Comfort earning credibility with clinicians matters more than credentials.
• Provider-facing or clinical-workflow products; marketplaces, workflow tools, or data-rich products.
• Products that earn repeated use from busy professionals and apply consumer-grade engagement craft in a professional setting.

Compensation and Setup

Base salary, plus bonus and equity. Fully remote within the United States, with travel to providers and industry events.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Healerz is an equal-opportunity employer and actively welcomes candidates from backgrounds underrepresented in product leadership and healthcare technology.

added.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Query
added.description:
The MongoDB Query Team is seeking a Senior Staff Product Manager to provide division-wide, product leadership for our fast, modular distributed query engine and flexible query system. As the most senior product management contributor, you will shape the multi-year strategy, product architecture, and market trajectory for the entire Query business unit.

You will be the primary product authority on the most complex trade-offs, anticipating systemic risks and cutting through structural friction that blocks multiple teams and initiatives. This role requires collaboration with distinguished engineers to rigorously debate strategy and pressure-test assumptions and advise executive leadership on options that balance long-term monetization, strategy, and business outcomes. And, where relevant, owns the pricing and monetization strategy for the product line.

This role can be in-office, flexible (hybrid), or remote anywhere in the US.

Responsibilities

Product Vision and Roadmap: Spearhead strategic unity across multiple product areas over a multi-year horizon to drive a coherent product experience
Business Leadership: Originate and de-risk the division’s most consequential strategic bets, owning rigorous business cases and advising leadership on multi-year economic outcomes
Customer Advocacy: Engage with strategically significant customers at the senior level (e.g., advisory boards and executive briefings) to surface cross-portfolio opportunities and inform the roadmap
PM Excellence: Elevate the global standard of product management by mentoring Staff and Senior PMs and pioneering new data-driven playbooks across the organization. Create frameworks and standards for customer and market research that others use for conducting high-quality customer and market research
Cross-Functional Alignment and Execution: Partner with Directors and VPs to shape investment allocation and sequencing across the query, developer experiences, and core database portfolio
Market and Engagement: Act as a primary external face for the product line, representing MongoDB to the industry, developers, standards bodies and at major conferences

Requirements

Experience: 10+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership in product management for platform, infrastructure, or database domains
Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical issues simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership
Strategic Execution: Proven success in delivering complex cross-functional projects and the ability to write, defend, and execute on multi-year business cases
Education: B.Sc. in a technical discipline, with Computer Science preferred, or equivalent relevant experience
Domain Expertise: Deep technical fluency in database query engines, query languages (SQL, MQL, etc.), developer experiences, distributed systems, and potentially AI platform tooling or LLM orchestration

Nice to Have

MBA, M.Sc., or Ph.D. in relevant technical or business domains
Experience with MongoDB or other non-relational database technologies
Demonstrated success leading products targeting developer personas in fast-paced, growing environments
Familiarity with open-source and cloud-native technologies

About MongoDB

Required Notification:
Certain states require that job postings indicate a minimum and maximum base salary in an effort to not discriminate – a very worthwhile purpose that Media Recruiting Group supports. MRG’s practices are and have always been non-discriminatory, and jobs are open to all candidates with respect to race, color, religion, national origin, military status, sexual orientation, sex/gender, age, national origin, disability, etc. That said, companies require that we supply them with candidates with very specific experience, and the commensurate compensation for every job varies. It is a function of a person’s years of experience, type of experience, skills, knowledge of certain computer programs, etc. And every job may have a unique requirement. And every job could come in higher or lower than the range we are given. We do not control the upper and lower ranges for our clients, so we make a best efforts attempt to include information requested by said states. In the case of sales people, most time it is also a function of their contacts. If the job is an analyst, analytical skills and experience matter. Etc. This makes stating a reasonable minimum and maximum challenging absent all of this information about a given candidate. Companies also have other elements of compensation, including but not limited to, commission, bonus, equity, profit sharing, varying levels of healthcare coverage and how much a person would have to contribute to the premium, various perks like continuing education, commuter reimbursement, phone reimbursement, etc. – not included in “salary” as the law states. Thus, know that anything we note in a salary range does NOT include such other compensation elements. And, as recruiters, we don’t know what all of those elements are, as we are recruiting for a company, not for ourselves, and they do not brief us as to each benefit. We are a 3rd party and can only estimate to the best of our knowledge, and thus offer the minimum and maximum salary MRG in good faith believes at the time of the posting the client is willing to pay for the advertised job.

Qualified by all of the above, for this job with requisite/required years of the required experience and skills, the minimum and maximum salary is approximated at $140,000 to $160,000 respectfully, exclusive of commission, bonus, equity, profit sharing, any element of healthcare coverage, any reference to how much a person would have to contribute to the premium of a healthcare plan, any perks, or other forms of compensation. Fewer years of experience could bring the base salary lower, and more experience could bring the base salary higher, if the company is willing to increase their salary bands.
